transkript.t: Here's how to create a scroll animation for your website in just 4 steps.
First, ask chat.gbt or claw to create a detailed video prompt.
My idea was matcha latte building itself ingredient by ingredient.
Next, paste that prompt into Google Flow and generate your video.
Once it's generated, download your video, make sure it's one smooth continuous sequence
so everything flows naturally when you turn it into a scroll animation.
